propositions: The unread baseline_advanced_at stamp is written on every pass and should be deleted since it is read nowhere in src/.
Rewriting an unchanged baseline scatters edits across an 18 MB sorted file, causing pathological git delta compression that a write-when-changed guard in set_baseline avoids.
Deleting the stamp cuts marginal packed cost per bindings.json version from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB; the guard itself is currently byte-neutral.
set_baseline must preserve present-but-null baseline keys (if k in fields semantics) so a missing key is not misinterpreted as no-ancestor local-wins.
Two consecutive reconciler passes over unchanged Jira state must produce a byte-identical bindings.json and create no commit.
Both the reconcile._advance_baselines and inbound-adopt callers must be covered by the change.
